title: 3862. Find the Smallest Balanced Index

examples.explanation: For index i = 1: Left sum = nums[0] = 2 Right product = nums[2] = 2 Since the left sum equals the right product, index 1 is balanced. No smaller index satisfies the condition, so the answer is 1.
For index i = 2: Left sum = 2 + 8 = 10 Right product = 2 * 5 = 10 Since the left sum equals the right product, index 2 is balanced. No smaller index satisfies the condition, so the answer is 2.
